_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the craft judge returned them, round 3 (the cap); each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: True blacks and light type; 2 and 9 closest to the showstopper; the cover a rounded box lit frontally; 5 repeats it; 4 a mannequin before a doghouse; 6's lime vest and starfield window; 7 one-material noise with a dead bottom; 8 blinds; 3 credible with a dead band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One night world, dark track, ember spine; 6's wood and vest and 7's strata sit outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral and drawn count traces; c24 and c8 apart; AJOT republication; the cover's 'now do' firmer than c7.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A corporate plan told clearly; no body, county or deadline.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns it, 2 pays, 6 turns; 5 a reshoot of 1; 7 a detour.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Trade words, no boosterism; wire-copy cadence; a flat hook on 6.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Racks, lateral and worker at a gate repeat no. 68; floodlit repeats nos. 67 and 59.

artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A raking oblique with lit crowns and casts, a pool on the banded five.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A rounded box lit head-on; no jaws; blurred column.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Jaws with die pads, the key at azimuth -60 elevation 26, grime, a sharp tool joint above.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: One-material noise; dead bottom; dot rig.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Three strata materials, a pool along the lateral, crop the empty bottom.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Starfield window; lime vest; one console.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The floodlit floor through the glass; the vest in sun-worn safety yellow.
Key from the upper left, behind the gate rail, stands spaced.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Duplicates the cover; flat band; prism slips.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A low three-quarter at the rotary; remove the band's emissive term.
